ambiguities.text: TransactionTypeContractCreationError references 'a transaction type that prohibits it' without specifying which types prohibit contract creation.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume blob transactions (type 3) prohibit contract creation based on EIP-4844 specification. Requires cross-reference with transaction type rules.

ambiguities.text: InvalidBlobVersionedHashError does not specify all validity conditions for versioned hashes.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume validity requires: correct version byte prefix (0x01), correct hash length (32 bytes), and valid KZG commitment correspondence.

implicit_assumptions.description: Exception types assume the transaction data has been correctly deserialized before validation begins.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malformed RLP data could bypass type-specific validation if deserialization errors are not caught first.

implicit_assumptions.description: The system assumes attackers cannot forge valid blob versioned hashes without possessing the corresponding blob data.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Hash forgery could allow inclusion of invalid or missing blob data in blocks.

implicit_assumptions.description: Fee validation assumes block base fee is correctly computed from parent block parameters.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Incorrect base fee calculation could allow transactions with insufficient fees or reject valid transactions.
